name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens details in complex scenes where EXCAVA’s current upscaler blurs edges or loses depth cues, directly boosting output quality. The trade-off is compute cost—depth-aware upscaling runs slower than standard methods—but the 0.5%+ capability gain justifies it for high-value outputs. Skip RealVisXL’s face-preserving upscaler until depth-aware tests confirm it’s the bottleneck.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under depth shifts because the model confuses facial depth cues with background noise. Instead, test RealVisXL’s face-focused upscaler first; it’s purpose-built for facial detail, and Anthropic’s pipeline lock is a risk only if we ignore the 0.5% gain from a tool that actually targets the failure mode. Run a blind A/B test: 100 faces upscaled by both methods, scored by a non-engineer on clarity—no shell commands, just the decision and the artifact.
